oil.when: 2013 (Service reminder in the display Settings > Maintenance menu)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Stop the vehicle, set the parking brake and turn the ignition to ON.
Use the display buttons to select Settings in the display between the gauges and press ENTER.
Select Service (the oil and oil filter reminder) and choose the option to reset the distance.
oil.note: This reminder is a distance you set yourself, not an oil-life sensor. Match it to the interval in your maintenance schedule.

steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
Drive above 16 mph (25 km/h). The light does not go out right after you add air; it goes out once the system re-reads the tires while driving.
If the light stays on after a few miles, recheck all four pressures with a gauge.
tpms.note: If the light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault or a wheel without a sensor (such as the spare) is fitted. A reset will not clear it; have it checked. Checked in the 2013 and 2019 owner's manuals.
